sentences.text: Cooper, a 6-year-old neutered male Labrador Retriever, is on day 46 of 56 of an owner-entered Royal Canin HP trial, hydrolysed soy, since May 18, with no chicken-free day recorded since Jun 8.
Chicken appears in 29 of 154 meals and treats: Dentastix, whose label lists chicken, daily from Jun 8 on the owner-entered allowed list, and at least 4 off-list feedings, the last on Jun 27.

Itching has 16 entries on 16 of 43 logged days over at least 35 days, and the record is not a test of the diet: Apoquel 16 mg once daily, doses not logged, NexGard from Jun 5 and Dentastix from Jun 8 all overlap the trial.
The NexGard chews on Jun 5 and Jul 2 have flavour protein unknown and are not counted off-list.
